text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Hundreds of municipal stands in the Zimbabwe capital Harare could be repossessed as the city council widens investigations into illegal allocation of houses and stands.
- The processing of Zimbabwe's import and export goods through the southern Beitbridge border post is set to be speeded up with the deployment of 49 more customs officials to the post.
- One person was killed and two others seriously injured when a rifle-wielding man ran amok at a house in Zimbabwe's southern city of Bulawayo on Tuesday morning.
